refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to get the current token from a lexer

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoLexerGetToken function gets the current token from object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: A pointer to a SilikoToken object representing the curent token. This object is managed by object and must not be pased to SilikoTokenDestroy. The pointer is valid until SilikoLexerAdvance is called on object.
